The Claude session, working from your memory, said on 13 October: "The intake rota stays fortnightly, as agreed on 1 October, but the overlap call at each hand-off grows from fifteen to thirty minutes." Its second statement gives the reason: "Fifteen minutes covered the open cases but not the ones that arrived during the hand-off week."

That replaces the fifteen-minute overlap in the 1 October intake rota and pantry call, and adds to what Dario said on that call: "The pantry restocks any shelf when it falls below a third full." It also adds to what Priya said there: "Both start on the first of November."

The rota stays fortnightly from the first of November, and pantry shelves restock when they fall below a third full. The hand-off overlap is thirty minutes rather than fifteen, because fifteen left the hand-off week's arrivals uncovered.

That suggests to me the thirty-minute call is now the figure to book, and anything set up for fifteen needs changing before November. If that holds, the pantry line and the start date stay as they were, and only the call length changes.

Two questions. Does thirty minutes cover the arrivals from the hand-off week, or do the open cases still need a separate check? Does the first of November still hold for the longer call, or does it begin at the next hand-off?
